== Anti-Crystal Blast Charge == [[File:Anti-Crystal Blast Charge orb.png|right|alt=Anti-Crystal Blast Charge, focus orb]] [[File:AntiCrystalBlastCharge.png|thumb|right|upright|420px|Anti-Crystal Blast Charge]] This explosive device can be used to clear away unwanted crystals. Perfect to clear an area of green crystals that are distracting your kobolds from purple crystals beyond.
Destroys all crystals regardless of color, so use with care! Usable in collection [[challenges]]. * Acquired by: ** {{Verified|Killing boss monsters in any challenge. (~4-5% chance for them to drop a random challenge item)}}, [[Bound to Character]]. ** Purchase from the [[DDOstore/Gear_and_Equipment#Challenge Tools|DDO Store]], [[Bound to Account]]. * Usable in the following collection challenges: '''Extraplanar Mining:'''
